newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY MIXED ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY MIXED ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted mixed against hard currencies at the close of Thursday's interbank session, dealers said.

"The market was a touch long and we saw the Zimbabwe dollar appreciating to 11.2800/2900 (on the key U.S. dollar) before the central bank came in to mop up all the excess money around," one dealer said.
He said the local unit finally closed at 11.2925/3025, unchanged from the previous day, while against sterling it strengthned to 18.4800/5300 from Wednesday's 18.6350/6600.
It also edged up on South Africa's rand to 2.5300/5400 from 2.5320/5500 but was quoted easier on the mark at 6.6700/6900 compared to 6.6675/6755.
